svg.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: The hotel: three prices, three questions
svg.desc: Three hotel scenes. A ledger gives each guest's share of the year's bill: the average loaded rate, which answers who pays. A new wing's cost per room: long-run incremental cost, which answers whether to build. The last room on a sold-out night is worth what the turned-away guest would pay: the shadow price, which answers who gets scarce capacity; on a half-empty night it is near zero.

text.tspan: The year's bill ÷ the room-nights it can
Half-empty night: one more guest costs
